workload.note: Linux on-demand, no reservations, no committed-use discounts

methodology_notes: AWS bulk price list does NOT encode the 100 GB/mo free egress allowance; Azure's retail API DOES (as a $0.00 tier). Comparing raw API output overstates AWS egress by 25%. Both are normalised here to 100 GB free.
Azure egress query must filter to 'Routing Preference: Internet'. Filtering by minimum price returns the Inter-Availability Zone meter at $0.01/GB -- ~9x too low.
